pairs.subject: trust-base
pairs.evidence: clients/typescript/src/journal.ts:253 Crash-journal lines are decoded with JSON.parse straight into an `any` binding, then fields are read and the record is cast to JournalRecord. No type-aware lint (no eslint / @typescript-eslint no-unsafe-* config exists in the package or the repo CI) counts this flow, so these trust-base members are invisible to a directive census, and the technique's removal step (decode into `unknown` and narrow through one checker) is not taken here.

techniques.evidence: clients/typescript/src/journal.ts:253 Decoded JSON flows into `any` (also index.ts:215 parsed: any, index.ts:621 `as any`, admission.ts:221 `as any[]`). The package has no type-aware unsafe-flow lint, so nothing counts these members. Removal is partial: request() returns Promise<unknown>, but its caller re-widens the result to any.
clients/typescript/tsconfig.json:10 The only checker is tsc strict mode. No proof rests on a platform fact such as word size or endianness.
clients/typescript/package.json:22 The devDependencies are only @types/node, tsx and typescript. The package carries no prover or specification library, so nothing leaks into the published graph.
